title: Two senders with no name on one channel read as two speakers: the second carries its rank after the channel's label, and the turns are labelled
notes: An event the application sends from ws, with no participant, then a message alice sends through ws, with no name: two sources under one channel label. The second source to speak in the turns read reads '@ws (2)', as a look-alike name carries its rank, and speakers are counted by source, so the room's turns are labelled and carry the speaker note. roomkit-rs's rule, which Python adopts (RMK-1221, the maintainer's choice): Python read both as '@ws', one speaker, unlabelled.
